description: A test class for client search functionalities in the Fineract project, specifically testing various client search scenarios using the integration test framework. It extends a base IntegrationTest class and contains setup methods and multiple test cases verifying search behavior by different client attributes.

classes.name: ClientSearchTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending IntegrationTest for testing client search capabilities, including searching by last name, external ID, account number, display name, mobile number, client identifier, and legal form. It sets up REST API request/response specifications and uses a helper class for client operations.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured, sets request and response specifications, and creates a ClientHelper instance before each test.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_WithLastnameText_WithPaging
methods.description: Tests that searching clients by last name with pagination returns correct total elements and page counts.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_WhenNoExternalIdForClients
methods.description: Validates search results when clients have null external IDs.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_WithLastnameTextOnDefaultOrdering
methods.description: Checks that client search by last name returns clients ordered by creation order (default).

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_WithLastnameText_OrderedByIdAsc
methods.description: Tests ordering of client search results by client ID in ascending order.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_ByExternalId
methods.description: Verifies that search by a specific external ID returns the correct client.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_ByAccountNumber
methods.description: Confirms searching by account number retrieves the correct client.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_ByDisplayName
methods.description: Validates that search by display name returns the correct client.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_ByMobileNo
methods.description: Checks that searching by mobile number retrieves the correct client.

methods.name: testClientSearchDoesntReturnAnything_ByMobileNo
methods.description: Ensures search by an unassociated mobile number returns no results.

methods.name: testClientSearchWorks_ByClientIdentifier
methods.description: Verifies search by client identifier (e.g., document key) returns the correct client.

methods.name: testClientSearchByLegalForm
methods.description: Tests filtering clients by legal form ID within a specific office.
